description: SocialCrawl credit guard: counts each paid API call's worst case against a silent session cap (min(500, 25% of the balance)) when the command is a plain curl, and asks only at a cap step, before a call it can't count, such as a transcript call, which gets its per-unit price and a cheaper route, or on any other command carrying a SocialCrawl URL (denied unattended). The same script on PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure counts an asked call once it has run. A call it can't record (no session lock in 4 seconds, no session folder, a save that fails) is refused, attended and unattended. Fires on Bash and only acts on socialcrawl.dev commands. It reads the balance once a session (0 credits, at most 3 tries), logs each unattended deny and paid pass, and on an error of its own it allows attended and denies unattended.
